rules.title: Lasidao · Rules
rules.flowHtml:
Players & win: 2–5 players. Reach 10 points to win (ties allowed).

Setup: 3 villagers each, plus 1 Breed Villagers function card. Auto-roll for first player (ties re-roll), announce, then deal into round 1.

Board: Resource / Function / Building areas, slots 1–6. Deal per round: resource 6+n, function 2+n, building 1+n (n = round−1), caps 12 / 6 / 6. Odd function/building slots face-up; even face-down (owner-only until built).

Decks: Draw + discard per type; empty draw reshuffles discard.

Personal board: Slots 1–6; no no-number slots by default (Expand adds +1 each). Building limit 6 (+1 per Expand). Function hand limit 5. Villager cap 12.

  1. Produce: Roll dice equal to idle villagers; send all dice of one face to a matching area slot or your built building of that number; or void (−1 villager). Remote Dice before rolling lets you choose faces.
  2. Settle: Aggregate & cancel equal counts per area+slot. Resource: 1st gets sum of large shares, 2nd small. Function/Building: 1st takes all cards. Neutral bandits cancel/rank but claim nothing.
  3. Settle act: Efficiency bonus, Build House, etc., or pass.
  4. Build: Pay to construct placed buildings; use functions; or pass. Score buildings score on build.
  5. Round end: Breed/Harvest etc., or pass. Top gainer +1 villager.
  6. Redeal: Clear leftover board tiles to discard, deal next round, produce again.

Anytime: Built Exchanges can trade freely. Some functions are anytime.
rules.funcHtml: <dl class="las-rules-dl"><dt>Breed (8)</dt><dd>Round end: pay food equal to current villagers; +1 villager (max 12).</dd><dt>Harvest (4)</dt><dd>Round end: gain any 2 resources (1 each).</dd><dt>Remote Dice (4)</dt><dd>Before rolling: choose any faces when dispatching.</dd><dt>Exile (4)</dt><dd>Anytime: remove 1 villager of a target on a chosen number slot.</dd><dt>Build House (8)</dt><dd>Settle/Build: pay 4 wood 3 stone 2 iron; +1 score.</dd><dt>Redraw (4)</dt><dd>Anytime: redraw 1 from function or building deck.</dd><dt>Bandit Raid (4)</dt><dd>Anytime, free: place 2 neutral dice on any area number slot; they cancel/rank but claim nothing.</dd><dt>Expand (4)</dt><dd>Auto-uses on gain, free: +1 no-number building slot and +1 building limit; never enters hand.</dd></dl>
rules.buildHtml: <dl class="las-rules-dl"><dt>Resource building · Rich</dt><dd>Cost 4 wood 4 stone 1 iron. Place on a number slot; with workers produces 2 of its resource. 2 per resource.</dd><dt>Resource building · Poor</dt><dd>Cost 2 wood 2 stone. Produces 1. 2 per resource. Cannot use no-number slots.</dd><dt>Score building (+2) (5)</dt><dd>Cost 5 wood 5 stone 3 iron. +2 score when built; no-number OK; no workers.</dd><dt>Exchange (6)</dt><dd>Cost 2 wood 2 stone. Anytime, unlimited: N identical resources → 1 any. N by owned count: 1→4, 2→3, 3→2, ≥4→1. No workers; no-number OK.</dd><dt>Refinery (4)</dt><dd>Cost 2 wood 2 stone 1 iron. Each built copy: after claiming board resources this round, assign +1 to a resource once (stackable). No-number OK.</dd></dl>
